## How it works

- **Start with exercise 1.** It takes about 45 minutes. Exercises 2 and 3 build on it and are coming soon.
- **Work in your IDE.** Positron or VS Code, with Posit Assistant, Claude Code or Copilot Chat. See [Agentic coding](../agentic/agentic.qmd) for the setup.
- **Use any language you have.** The project mixes R, Python and Stata. Python alone is enough; the AI can explain or rewrite the other parts.
- **Copy each prompt** with the copy button, one at a time, and check the answer against "What you should see".
- **Use only the files provided.** Do not upload confidential material to a tool your organization has not approved.
